sentences.en: Which is the most densely populated country in the world?
sentences.zh: 哪个国家是世界上人口最密集的？

sentences.en: Kabylie, a region located in northeastern Algeria, is densely populated.
sentences.zh: 凯比利位于阿尔及利亚东北部，人口稠密。

sentences.en: Kabylie is the most densely populated rural area in Algeria.
sentences.zh: 凯比利是阿尔及利亚人口最密集的农村地区。
